title: Determine a safe, sustainable learning-support model for a Taoyuan after-school program
owner_org: 永豐靈糧堂課後輔導班
owner_statement: The public YZU field-matching listing reports that the after-school program serves 14 primary-school children from families needing additional support, expects several students to enter junior high, and is concerned that existing staffing may not be sufficient for one-to-one or small-group academic support. It asks whether YZU students could provide recurring tutoring, short enrichment activities, or service-learning/USR project support.
schedule: Source reports weekdays approximately 15:30-18:00/20:00 with flexibility for volunteers.
affected_actors: 14 primary-school children currently reported by the source
children expected to transition into junior-high-level coursework
constraints: Do not treat reported staffing concern as verified evidence that tutoring is the binding cause of academic outcomes.
Any YZU participation must fit the program's operating schedule and supervision capacity.
The source page heading says Zhongli while the listed street address is in Taoyuan District; geography should be confirmed with the owner.
Do not copy child identities, family details, educational records, or private contact information into public Commons artifacts.
available_resources: existing class-management process reported by source
child-safety management process reported by source
requested_support: service-learning, USR, or small-team project collaboration
uncertainties: The source page does not establish whether the need is still current in September 2026.
The number and age distribution of children may have changed since the listing was created.
The listing does not quantify tutor-to-student capacity, attendance, learning baseline, or what outcome the owner would prioritize.
The listing proposes several collaboration modes but does not establish which mode the owner currently prefers or can supervise.
No funding, stipend, course-credit, or volunteer commitment is established by the listing.
safeguarding_notes: Direct work with children requires explicit owner approval, appropriate supervision, and compliance with YZU and host child-safeguarding requirements.
The Commons candidate itself authorizes no direct contact with children or access to educational/family records.
data_access_notes: No participant-level educational data should be requested during initial curation.
Any later learning measurement must use minimum-necessary, owner-approved and appropriately protected data.

suggested_work.title: Confirm the current learning-support bottleneck and participation constraints
suggested_work.description: Review the public listing with the potential owner and establish whether the need remains current, what support is actually scarce, what outcomes matter, what supervision exists, and what safeguarding/access constraints apply.

suggested_work.title: Design a bounded recurring tutoring lane
suggested_work.description: If the owner confirms recurring tutoring is useful, design a small supervised schedule, role definition, onboarding boundary, escalation path, and lightweight outcome/attendance measurement without overclaiming causal impact.
suggested_work.effort: 1-3 weeks design before any live service
required_credentials: host-approved child-facing participant for live execution

suggested_work.title: Design one short enrichment project that can be evaluated independently
suggested_work.description: If the owner prefers project-based support, create one bounded English, science, or introductory programming module with an explicit learning goal, required materials, supervision plan, and simple pre/post or rubric-based evaluation.
suggested_work.effort: 1-3 weeks design plus owner-approved delivery window
required_credentials: host-approved child-facing participant for live execution

notes: This intake is a curator reconstruction of a public YZU field-matching listing. It is not an owner submission to Problem Commons and must not be represented as owner endorsement until reviewed with the organization.
